A fuzzy system adjusts Air Conditioner (AC)  
Speed based on Room Temperature and  
Occupancy. The fuzzy sets are:  
Room Temperature: {Cool, Warm, Hot}  
Occupancy: {Few, Moderate, Full}  
AC Speed: {Low, Medium, High}

IF Room Temperature is Hot AND Occupancy is  
Full THEN AC Speed is High  
IF Room Temperature is Warm AND Occupancy  
is Moderate THEN AC Speed is Medium  
IF Room Temperature is Cool OR Occupancy is  
Few THEN AC Speed is Low

$$Temperature = 82°F - pHot = 0.8, hWarm = 0.2$$  
$$Occupancy = 6 people - uFull = 0.7, Moderate$$  
$$= 0.3, uFew = 0$$  
Compute the firing strength for each rule. Explain  
briefly how the final AC Speed decision would be  
influenced.
